headline: Wall Street Breathes Thanks to the "Jensen Huang Effect" on NVIDIA
summary: The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite rose 6.51% to 24,089.56 points and the S&P 500 gained 4.74% to 7,237.90, with the moves attributed to Nvidia's rally.
why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite are the main benchmarks for US equities, so their large single-day moves affect portfolios and sentiment worldwide.

impacts.why: The index posted a 4.74% gain in the session described.
